text.EN: I can't refill that right now.
text.TL: Hindi ko malalagyan ng laman iyon ngayon.

text.EN: There is no known clean water source nearby.
text.TL: Walang kilalang malinis na tubig sa malapit.

text.EN: The container is already completely full.
Too exposed to stand around pumping water.
text.TL: Masyadong lantad para magbomba ng tubig.

text.EN: I won't approach that water source. It's a death trap.
text.TL: Di ako lalapit sa tubig na 'yan. Bitag 'yan.

text.EN: Can't refill. No suitable vessel available.
text.TL: Di makapagpuno. Walang angkop na sisidlan.

text.EN: Water is tainted there. I refuse to collect it.
text.TL: Marumi ang tubig doon. Tumatanggi akong kumuha.

text.EN: We need to deal with threats before refilling.
text.TL: Harapin muna natin ang banta bago magpuno.

text.EN: I can't refill that under current danger.
text.TL: Di ko malalagyan 'yan sa gitna ng panganib.
